name: Pip
personality: Bouncy, always in a hurry, talks before you finish saying hello.

lines.text: Hi-hi! It's Pip! Are you open? You're open. Great!
Pip here! Quick call, I'm mid-hop.
The [dish], please! To the lily pad by the bridge. You know the one.
[dish]! Hot as you can make it! Okay bye! Wait. Thank you! Okay bye!
Do you deliver to ponds? Asking for me.

choices.text: Only if you bring a towel.
The bridge is as close as we get.
